page.expiredBody: It may have expired, been turned off, or the address is incomplete. Ask the person who sent it to make a new one.

setup.title: Set up single sign-on
setup.body: For {{org}}. When it's done, people at your verified domains sign in with your identity provider.
setup.bodyDomain: For {{org}}. When it's done, people at {{domain}} sign in with your identity provider.
setup.back: Close the page any time: this link brings you back here.
setup.loadFailed: The setup didn't load. Reload the page; this link keeps your place.

domain.body: Only people with an email at a domain you've verified are sent to your identity provider. You'll add a TXT record at your DNS provider.

connect.which: Which identity provider do you use?
connect.connected: {{idp}} · SAML · Draft until it's turned on

okta.name: Okta
okta.howBody: In Okta's Admin Console: Applications, Create App Integration, SAML 2.0. Name it Qeet ID.
okta.sendBody: On the app's Sign On tab, download the metadata file (or copy its URL).
okta.fix1: In Okta, open the app's Sign On tab

entra.name: Microsoft Entra ID
entra.how: Create the app in Entra ID
entra.howBody: In the Microsoft Entra admin center: Enterprise applications, New application, Create your own application, then Single sign-on and SAML. Name it Qeet ID.
entra.send: Send Qeet ID Entra ID's details
entra.sendBody: Under SAML Certificates, download the Federation Metadata XML.
entra.fix1: In Entra ID, open the app's Single sign-on page

google.name: Google Workspace
google.how: Create the app in Google Workspace
google.howBody: In the Google Admin console: Apps, Web and mobile apps, Add app, Add custom SAML app. Name it Qeet ID.
google.sendBody: On the Google identity provider details page, download the metadata.
google.fix1: In the Google Admin console, open the app's details

other.name: your identity provider
other.how: Create a SAML 2.0 app for Qeet ID
other.howBody: In your identity provider, add a SAML 2.0 application and name it Qeet ID.
other.sendBody: Download its SAML metadata file, or note its entity ID, sign-in URL and signing certificate.
other.fix1: In your identity provider, open the app's SAML settings

test.body: Last, sign in once through {{idp}} as yourself, to see exactly what it sends.
test.waiting: Waiting for {{idp}} in the other tab…
test.passedBody: This is what it sent. People are matched to Qeet ID by their email.
test.name: Name
test.fix1Body: Download the signing certificate again: {{idp}} may have rotated it.
test.fix2Body: Paste the new certificate, or add the metadata file again.
test.expired: The test sign-in ran out of time. Test again.
test.popupBlocked: Your browser blocked the new tab. Allow pop-ups for this page, then test again.

turnOn.body: From now on, people at {{domain}} who sign in to {{org}}'s applications go to {{idp}}. You can turn it off again here or in the console.
turnOn.liveBody: People at {{domain}} now sign in with {{idp}}.

scim.body: Let {{idp}} add, update and remove {{org}}'s people in Qeet ID, so nobody has to do it by hand. You can do this later from the same link.
scim.skipped: Not now: turn it on any time from this link
scim.doneBody: People at {{domain}} sign in with {{idp}}, and {{idp}} keeps them in step. Nothing else to do.

addSaml.title: Add {{idp}}'s details
addSaml.body: Enter the details from your identity provider, or fill them in from its metadata file.
addSaml.metadataHint: XML, from your identity provider's SAML app settings
addSaml.metadataError: This file isn't SAML metadata from an identity provider. Download it again, or enter the details by hand.
addSaml.name: Connection name
addSaml.nameHelp: People see this name when they choose how to sign in.
addSaml.certError: This isn't a certificate. Paste the whole PEM block, or the base64 value from the metadata.
addSaml.emailHelp: Leave it empty to use the NameID.
addSaml.draftHelp: Not used for sign-in yet. You can test it.
addSaml.activeHelp: People at your verified domains sign in with it.
addSaml.failedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Your details are kept: try again.

verifyDomain.title: Verify a domain
verifyDomain.domainBody: Enter the domain in your people's email addresses.
verifyDomain.recordBody: Add this TXT record at your DNS provider, then choose Verify.
verifyDomain.missingTitle: We couldn't find the record yet
verifyDomain.missingBody: DNS changes can take up to an hour to appear. Check the name and value, then try again; this link keeps your place.
verifyDomain.takenTitle: This domain belongs to another organisation
verifyDomain.takenBody: Another organisation on Qeet ID has verified it. If that's wrong, tell the person who sent you this link.
verifyDomain.verifiedBody: People with an email at this domain will be sent to your identity provider when they sign in.

removeConnection.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
removeConnection.body: People at {{domain}} won't be able to sign in with {{idp}} until you add a connection again. This can't be undone.
removeConnection.bodyNoDomain: People won't be able to sign in with {{idp}} until you add a connection again. This can't be undone.
removeConnection.failedBody: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

scimToken.body: Copy it now: for security it's shown only once.
scimToken.newBody: Replace the old token in {{idp}}'s provisioning settings with this one.
scimToken.firstBody: In {{idp}}'s provisioning settings, enter this endpoint and token.

turnOffSso.title: Turn off single sign-on?
turnOffSso.body: People at {{domain}} will stop signing in with {{idp}} and use {{org}}'s other ways to sign in. The connection stays, so you can turn it on again here.
turnOffSso.failedBody: Try again. If it keeps happening, turn it off in the console.

turnOffScim.title: Turn off SCIM provisioning?
turnOffScim.body: {{idp}} will stop adding, updating and removing {{org}}'s people in Qeet ID. Nobody is removed now: the people added so far stay.
